I am recruiting for a funded doctoral position to join my new group at the University of Vienna, Austria, where I will begin as an Assistant Professor of Human-Computer Interaction in fall 2026. I am currently a Postdoctoral Researcher at Carnegie Mellon University.

Please feel free to share this announcement with prospective applicants and relevant networks - thank you!

Our research spans Human-Computer Interaction, Responsible AI, and Social Computing. Example topics include how people understand and respond to technological harm and how organizations can incorporate responsible AI into their innovation processes. We use mixed methods, including qualitative research, participatory design, experiments, and system building. The doctoral project will be developed around the candidate’s interests and strengths within these areas.

Applicants should hold a master’s degree or equivalent in computer science, HCI, design, social sciences, or a related field. The position is expected to begin on March 1, 2027, and provides funding for up to four years (the expected duration of the PhD).

Applications should include a CV, a motivation letter outlining ideas for a prospective doctoral project, degree certificates, and, if available, a list of publications and evidence of teaching experience.

Application deadline: October 15, 2026, at 14:00 CET
